title: Miller Industries to Present and Host 1x1 Investor Meetings at the 18th Annual Southwest IDEAS Investor Conference on November 18th & 19th in Dallas, TX
summary: Miller Industries press release from November 16, 2026.
body_markdown:
CHATTANOOGA, Tenn.


, Nov. 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Miller Industries, Inc. (NYSE:[MLR](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/miller-industries-to-present-and-host-1x1-investor-meetings-at-the-18th-annual-southwest-ideas-investor-conference-on-november-18th--19th-in-dallas-tx-302941015.html#financial-modal) ), the World's Largest Manufacturer of Towing and Recovery Equipment, today announced that Chief Executive Officer, William Miller II will present at the Southwest IDEAS Investor Conference on Wednesday November 18, 2026 at The Westin Convention Center at Las Colinas in Dallas, TX. Mr. Miller's presentation is scheduled to begin at 9:55 AM CT. The presentation is webcast and can be accessed through the conference host's main website:[https://www.threepartadvisors.com/southwest](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823475-1&h=3288329740&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.threepartadvisors.com%2Fsouthwest&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.threepartadvisors.com%2Fsouthwest) and on the investor relations page of the Company's website:[http://www.millerind.com/investors](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823475-1&h=4153589163&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.millerind.com%2Finvestors&a=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.millerind.com%2Finvestors) .


**About IDEAS Investor Conferences**


The IDEAS Investor Conferences are held annually and produced by Three Part Advisors, LLC. The mission of the IDEAS Conferences is to provide independent regional venues for quality companies to present their investment merits to an influential audience of investment professionals. Unlike traditional bank-sponsored events, IDEAS Investor Conferences are "SPONSORED BY INVESTORS. FOR INVESTORS." and for the benefit of regional investment communities. Conference sponsors collectively have more than $200 billion in assets under management and additional information can be found at[www.IDEASconferences.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823475-1&h=946581483&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ideasconferences.com%2F&a=www.IDEASconferences.com) .


If interested in participating or learning more about the IDEAS conferences, please contact Lacey Wesley at (817) 769 -2373 or[\[email protected\]](https://www.millerind.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#dcb08bb9afb0b9a59c9598999d8fbfb3b2bab9aeb9b2bfb9aff2bfb3b1) .


**About Miller Industries**


Miller Industries is The World's Largest Manufacturer of Towing and Recovery Equipment®, and markets its towing and recovery equipment under a number of well-recognized brands, including Century®, Vulcan®, Chevron™, Holmes®, Challenger®, Champion®, Jige™, Boniface™, Omars™, Titan® and Eagle®.
